scripts.db:use-sqlite: node -e "const fs=require('fs');let s=fs.readFileSync('prisma/schema.prisma','utf8');s=s.replace(/provider\s*=\s*\"postgresql\"/, 'provider = \"sqlite\"');fs.writeFileSync('prisma/schema.prisma', s);console.log('Switched Prisma to SQLite');"
scripts.db:use-postgres: node -e "const fs=require('fs');let s=fs.readFileSync('prisma/schema.prisma','utf8');s=s.replace(/provider\s*=\s*\"sqlite\"/, 'provider = \"postgresql\"');fs.writeFileSync('prisma/schema.prisma', s);console.log('Switched Prisma to PostgreSQL');"
